candidates.failure_scenario: `func main(cur realm) { xs := []int{7,8}; for cur := range xs { println(cur) } }` in a realm: a range DEFINE binds its key/value in the RangeStmt's own block, so isCrossingCurParam resolves the name to a *RangeStmt and returns false whatever n.Op is. The cost is a reader of this diff seeing the three swept write rules disagree about DEFINE for no behavioural reason, one hunk after the AssignStmt rule dropped the same guard.
